answer: Bind each identity to one hashed voter-registration record, checked against the public electoral roll, with only the hash stored. An atlas of fake accounts needs a distinct real voter behind every entry, and a duplicate hash is rejected at once, so bulk forgery collapses into recruiting real people one by one. Like quartz, the roll is hard to fake and easy to verify, and the single thread linking one voter to one identity cannot be split across a thousand accounts. Limit: it excludes non-voters, and rolls vary by jurisdiction.
